title: cellranger_mapping
description: A pipeline for running Cell Ranger mapping.

input.description: The fastq.gz files to align. Can also be a single directory containing fastq.gz files.
input.help_text: type: `array`, multiple: True, required, direction: `input`, example: `sample_S1_L001_R1_001.fastq.gz;sample_S1_L001_R2_001.fastq.gz`

reference.description: The path to Cell Ranger reference tar.gz file.
reference.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `input`, example: `reference.tar.gz`

output_raw.description: Location where the output folder from Cell Ranger will be stored.
output_raw.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `output`, example: `output_dir`

output_h5mu.description: The output from Cell Ranger, converted to h5mu.
output_h5mu.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `output`, example: `output.h5mu`

uns_metrics.description: Name of the .uns slot under which to QC metrics (if any).

output_type.description: Which Cell Ranger output to use for converting to h5mu.

expect_cells.description: Expected number of recovered cells, used as input to cell calling algorithm.

chemistry.description:
Assay configuration.
- auto: autodetect mode
- threeprime: Single Cell 3'
- fiveprime: Single Cell 5'
- SC3Pv1: Single Cell 3' v1
- SC3Pv2: Single Cell 3' v2
- SC3Pv3: Single Cell 3' v3
- SC3Pv3LT: Single Cell 3' v3 LT
- SC3Pv3HT: Single Cell 3' v3 HT
- SC5P-PE: Single Cell 5' paired-end
- SC5P-R2: Single Cell 5' R2-only
- SC-FB: Single Cell Antibody-only 3' v2 or 5'
See https://kb.10xgenomics.com/hc/en-us/articles/115003764132-How-does-Cell-Ranger-auto-detect-chemistry- for more information.

secondary_analysis.description: Whether or not to run the secondary analysis e.g. clustering.

generate_bam.description: Whether to generate a BAM file.

include_introns.description: Include intronic reads in count (default=true unless --target-panel is specified in which case default=false)

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
